summary: All six quality dimensions pass. No prior findings were raised, so nothing carries forward as unresolved. The seven changed paragraphs in the 'Prepare a software demonstration' section are each examined: the ICC process management description link is correctly cited and appropriately hedged; the illustrative example is labeled hypothetical; workflow decisions, roles, and records are consistent with the plan; no unverified capabilities are asserted; and the section stays within its assigned scope. Claims throughout the page are supported by the supplied sources and appropriately hedged against vendor descriptions and ISO APG educational guidance. The page stays within its assigned scope across all four subsections without encroaching on adjacent chapters. Prose is readable and non-repetitive. All cited URLs match the supplied research source URLs or the permitted internal site path. The FAQ section is present and assigned by the plan; it covers appropriate evaluation and implementation questions without asserting unverified capabilities. Illustrative examples are clearly labeled hypothetical. Workflow roles, inputs, decisions, records, and exceptions are present and consistent across all subsections.
